, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the transcript/timestamps, introducing an unfounded “integer-second” assumption and concluding only two species overlapped. The line “He fearlessly puts himself between the chicks and the petrel” at ~01:26 clearly implies all three species (Adélie penguin, emperor penguin chicks, and giant petrel) are on screen simultaneously. The Planner also failed to verify by watching an accessible version of the clip, leading to the incorrect answer of 2 instead of the correct 3.
